title: The lost dog
grammar: past simple: telling a story in order

scene.speaker: sofia
scene.bubble: The scariest afternoon of the year: for two hours, nobody knew where Luna was…
scene.intro: The scariest afternoon of the year: for two hours nobody knew where Luna was. First Sofía looked for her in the garden. Then she called her name at the lake. Then Mateo made a poster with her photo and put it on the bench in the park. They were very worried — until a small girl arrived with Luna on a lead. First, then, finally: that is how you tell a story!

activities.title: Put the story in order: match the moment with what happened.

Artist speed! … Sofia: At five, a boy phoned: a grey dog was sitting at the bakery door. … Mateo: Of course! The smell of fresh bread! … Sofia: The baker gave her water and a little bread roll. … Mateo: Now the gate has two locks. TWO!

activities.title: Grammar · When he got home…
activities.instructions: Read the sentences. Then choose the right word.

data.title: When he got home…
data.intro: Two things happened. When tells your reader which one came first — and it lets you put two short sentences into one good one.
data.can: I can join two past sentences with when to tell a story in order.

examples.text: When he got home, he had his dinner.
When Sofia came home, Luna wasn't there.
Mateo was very happy when he saw the dog.
When they looked under the bench, they found her!

rules: When + what happened first, then the other thing.
Start with When and you need a comma. Put it in the middle and you do not.
Both halves are in the past: When he got…, he had…
